findings: The company reports that its magnesium glycinate product is guaranteed to be a pure chelated magnesium bisglycinate consisting of elemental magnesium chelated with two molecules of glycine, avoiding the addition of magnesium oxide to inflate total magnesium content.

The company utilizes Albion Laboratories' patented fully reacted mineral amino acid chelation process (TRAACS) to bond elemental magnesium to glycine, which enables absorption through paths similar to amino acids rather than typical mineral ion absorption pathways.
The company reports that each regular strength tablet provides 100 mg of elemental magnesium derived from 740 mg of fully reacted magnesium bisglycinate.

The company reports that its formulation provides up to four times better absorption compared to conventional magnesium oxide formulations, supported by a clinical evaluation published by Vynckier et al. in the Journal of Nutrition & Food Science.

The company provides batch-level transparency for its formulations, screening every production run at the ingredient, formula, and finished-tablet stages for identity, strength, stability, heavy metals, microplastics, environmental toxins, and oxidation.

The company reports that its Magnesium Glycinate is a fully reacted amino acid chelate (magnesium bis-glycinate) manufactured through a unique, patented process to maximize absorption and intestinal tolerance [Wellness Pharmacy].
The company reports that its Magnesium Glycinate tablets achieve up to four times better absorption compared to standard magnesium oxide formulations [Metagenics].

The company reports that its Magnesium Glycinate ingredient profile excludes magnesium oxide, instead containing magnesium bis-glycinate alongside microcrystalline cellulose, croscarmellose sodium, vegetable stearic acid, and silica or silicon dioxide [Metagenics].

The rating rests on confirmed documentation that the company utilizes Albion's patented fully reacted TRAACS amino acid chelation technology to deliver a high-purity magnesium bisglycinate free from oxide blending, backed by third-party facility audits and rigorous batch-level purity screenings.
